faq.question: What is included in the rent?
faq.answer: Everything is included: furniture, internet, phone system, conference rooms, kitchen with coffee/tea, reception, cleaning, electricity, heating, and mail handling.

faq.question: Are the contracts flexible?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer flexible rental agreements that can be adapted to your needs, from weekly to long-term contracts.

faq.question: Where is DG97 located?
faq.answer: We are located at Drottninggatan 97 in Vasastan, Stockholm, close to Odenplan and Rådmansgatan metro stations.

faq.question: Can I book conference rooms?
faq.answer: Yes, all members have access to conference rooms that can be booked as needed. External guests can also book by the hour.
